#### Human hand

Muscles sit in the forearm and the hand. The 27 bones are 8 in the wrist, 5 in the palm and 14 in the fingers. Orange lines are five of the tendons that close the fingers.

Tendons Muscles, not motors

The 27 bones are 8 in the wrist, 5 in the palm and 14 in the fingers. The count of about 21 moving finger joints is our inference from how one maker, Shadow, models the hand.
